title: Bakken: the Williston system in and out on one page
dek: A one-way export system with two Enbridge doors. Supply is 1,233 kb/d and crude inflows are nil. Door 1 delivers at Clearbrook, the pricing point. Door 2 injects at Cromer, the apportionment gauge, and those barrels ride Line 65 down to the same Clearbrook price. One pipe flow anchors the system (Dakota Access, 611 kb/d in calendar 2024), rail loads about 170, Mandan refines 72, Bakken North runs nearly empty at about 25, and the remaining about 355 kb/d clears on pipes that publish capacity only, so storage change is the residual.
